title: Studio: a base and its <base>.custom as one surface — "customized" / "added" marks, "only customizations", the pair folded under its base, New lands in the pair
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-19 base + `.custom` as one surface (D3)"; schedule review correction 5 adds N-13. N-17 removed from `Blocked-by:` on the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-01, see the card thread). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28411, #28407

Serial: N-17 #28562 is in flight on the same lane; its branch diff touches `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `packages-io.ts`, which this card also touches. The claim names it under `Serial constraints cleared`, and the second to land rebases on the first.

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-19**) · governs: ADR-0146 D3 "On top, one surface", D2 (badge, customization list), Supersede row ADR-0029 D7 (contributed items drawn greyed with their source; this card adds the pin) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: L.

**Business reason.** A customer with many installed apps opens HotCRM in Studio and should see one HotCRM. Its items and their changes belong in the same list, marked, with a filter for "what did we change". Today `hotcrm.custom` would be one more row in the package switcher, and its new items are invisible from HotCRM.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- `PackageSwitcher` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:889`) lists every `fetchPackages()` row flat, so a pair gets its own row. `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts:111#customizationBasePackageId` answers a pair's base.
- Interfaces off-nav rails read `OFF_NAV_TYPES = ['page','dashboard','report','view']` (:2981) for the open package. A list scoped to X serves X's declared override in X's slot (N-10 #28507), but not the pair's other items.
- N-15 (#28411, open) will serve, per base: overrides, extensions, switched-off items and counts.
- No served read names the package that contributes a flow on the base's objects or a navigation entry. Whether the folded object read names an extension field's source package: not verified.

**Wanted.**
1. With a base open, each pillar rail lists the base's items and the pair's items in one list. A pair item that overrides is marked "customized", and any other pair item is marked "added". Both marks come from N-15 and the pair's list, never computed.
2. An "only customizations" filter on each rail, from the same read.
3. The switcher folds `<base>.custom` under its base, with no row of its own. A link to the pair opens the base's surface.
4. New, in any pillar, on a read-only base lands in the pair without asking, through the ensure door. The item header names the pair (D3). The pair-facing Publish is N-17's (see Not here); ⛔ this card adds no Publish path of its own.
5. Items another package contributes to the base are drawn greyed, with the source package named, for each kind a served read names. A kind with no served source is listed in the PR and left undrawn, with no client derivation, and the seat cuts a server card for it.
6. The ADR-0029 D7 Supersede row's pin: a test of the greyed drawing.

**Tests.** A base + pair fixture:
- one override is marked customized and one new item added;
- the filter shows exactly those two;
- the switcher has no pair row, and the pair's URL lands on the base;
- New on a read-only base writes into the pair;
- a contributed item draws greyed, naming its package;
- a base with no pair is unchanged.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own: the marks read N-15 (Blocked-by #28411), and New writes only through N-13 (#28407). A release without this card keeps the pair as an ordinary switcher row.

**Not here.** Customize, Restore and the pair-facing Publish (N-17). Landing counts (N-24). Directory marks (N-26b). Add-field on a base object (N-23c).

**Dedupe.** Searched `package switcher fold custom`, `only customizations filter`: only #28411 and closed siblings.

Links back: #28236, #28411, #28407, #28507, ADR-0146 D2, D3, ADR-0029 D7.
